name: Rock Glacier Detection Benchmark (terrain + multispectral integration)
description: Compares classifiers for integrating terrain analysis and multispectral remote sensing to detect rock glaciers automatically.
notes: Remote‑sensing benchmark with likely small, geographically biased labeled data; sensor- and season-specific effects, class imbalance, and limited generalization across regions are common caveats. Non‑LLM vision task.
